records.matter: Total reconstitution of a federal vaccine advisory committee after generalized conflict and capture claims
records.institution: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services / Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

source_packets.supports: Removal of all 17 sitting members, generalized conflict and rubber-stamp rationale, and explicit timing interest in appointing a majority before 2028.
The committee's stated expert qualification, disclosure, ethics, and public-deliberation requirements.

records.source_supports: The source-ten ACIP matter was independently recovered by the name-blind template and is preserved as a denominator overlap rather than counted as a new event.
source_does_not_establish: a member-specific conflict finding for each removed person
that the generalized capture claim was true or false
a new event distinct from the existing seed fixture
independent K0 adjudication

records.matter: 2021 reset of EPA science advisory committees after criticism of prior membership restrictions

source_packets.supports: Reestablishment of SAB and CASAC membership, criticism of the 2017 grant-recipient exclusion and appointment process, and a stated return to balanced expert recruitment.
Vacatur and remand of the grant-recipient prohibition and EPA's decision not to appeal.

records.source_supports: An incoming administration reset scientific advisory membership while treating prior eligibility restrictions and appointment practices as impairing independent expertise.
source_does_not_establish: one bounded member whose competence was reclassified
one explanation mutation delivered after a member-specific contradiction
that every prior or replacement appointment was captured
a complete ceiling-conversion event

records.matter: 2025 reset and 2026 reconstitution of EPA science advisory committees to reverse alleged politicization

source_packets.supports: A new nomination process described as reversing politicization of SAB and CASAC.
Selection of a chair and 36 SAB members following the reset.

records.source_supports: A later administration again used a generalized politicization rationale to reset and repopulate a scientific advisory body.
source_does_not_establish: member-specific evidence supporting the politicization classification
a documented qualified contradiction delivered by each displaced member
how the treatment of any bounded knower changed after contradiction
equivalence with the 2021 reset or the source-ten ACIP fixture

records.matter: Blanket exclusion of current EPA grant recipients from federal advisory committees

source_packets.supports: A rule treating current receipt of EPA grants as incompatible with advisory-committee independence.
Vacatur and remand of the blanket prohibition, with EPA returning to prior policies.

records.source_supports: Research-funding status was converted into an eligibility exclusion across advisory committees and later vacated after judicial review.
source_does_not_establish: one bounded removed member and complete employment or appointment consequence
that every grant relationship was irrelevant or every exclusion was retaliatory
a complete explanation-before and explanation-after chain
the motive or private psychology of individual officials

records.matter: Termination of the federal human-research-protections advisory committee
records.institution: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services

source_packets.supports: The committee's expert function, membership, ethics rules, public process, and stated continuing need.

records.source_supports: The record establishes termination of an expert advisory body and preserves its chartered function.
source_does_not_establish: a generalized capture or conflict claim used to justify termination
a qualified contradiction delivered before the termination
knower reclassification or explanation mutation

records.matter: Independent audit of FDA advisory-committee conflict determinations and disclosure transparency
records.institution: U.S. Government Accountability Office / Food and Drug Administration

source_packets.supports: Independent review of recusals, waivers, appearance issues, unpublished determination methods, and recommendations for guidance and transparency.

records.source_supports: An external auditor can inspect the conflict process, preserve recusal and waiver denominators, and require public reasons without treating all expert relationships as capture.
source_does_not_establish: that the FDA process is conflict-free
that every recusal or waiver was correct
that recommendations have been implemented effectively
a K0 event

records.matter: Ordinary staggered turnover and public-input appointment process for a scientific advisory committee

source_packets.supports: Nine new appointments, seven reappointments, staggered terms, public nominations, public comments, and stated expertise criteria.
Four new appointments and six reappointments under staggered terms and expertise criteria.

records.source_supports: The same appointment gate can operate through ordinary staggered turnover, public input, mixed renewal, and explicit expertise criteria.
source_does_not_establish: absence of every conflict or political influence
observed effectiveness of public comment
a committee-wide capture claim or purge
a ceiling-conversion event

records.matter: Published declaration, recusal, and conflict-management architecture for scientific advisory bodies
records.institution: United Kingdom scientific advisory committee system

source_packets.supports: Regular declarations, publication, prompt updates, and disclosure of financial and nonfinancial interests.
Quarterly review of interests and withdrawal from discussion or decision-making when a conflict is identified.

records.source_supports: A conflict claim can be processed through published declarations and item-specific recusal instead of total replacement or categorical exclusion.
source_does_not_establish: that every conflict is detected or disclosed
that recusal is always enforced
that the architecture has prevented a specific ceiling-conversion event
observed effectiveness across every committee
